title: The Harpy Express: Cat's Expresso
description: Cat's version of "The Last Voyage of the Harpy Express" modpack
body:
![cat's expresso](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/930558cfbf59653403eb48ff66a6e33151e839d2.png)

**🚂 A train murder mystery social game**

This modpack expands [The Last Voyage of the Harpy Express](https://modrinth.com/modpack/harpy-express) and [The Harpy Express: Extended](https://modrinth.com/modpack/the-harpy-express-extended) with extra features and including G'Express to create a perfect server experience.

## 📚 Features
- Extended Custom train layout
- Updated and configued roles, as well as additions from G'Express
- Modified Guidebook
- Extended Configuration Menu

Default Keybinds for the game:
- `V` Opens simple voice chat menu
- `R` & `G` For abilities
- `Left Alt` activates killer instinct
- `E` Opens your inventory, shop and selection abilites, your role is also shown at the top of your screen.
- To use the knife or simialr items, use your hit key (`Left Mouse`) to push a player or hold your interact key (`Right Mouse`) for 1 second to stab.
- To use the gun or similar items, aim and use your interact key (`Right Mouse`) to shoot.
- Other items may have special mechanics, read about your role in the Guidebook, and hover over the item in your inventory (`E`) to learn more.

All keybinds can be configured in the default minecraft settings.

## ❓ How to Play
1. Host a server with the provided world.
- Essentials Mod *is* installed automaticly for easy setup, but a dedicated server is recommended.
2. Ensure that voice chat is working and setup.
- For a dedicated server, make sure you are porting the voice chat port to public using the config file in `config/voicechat/voicechat-server.properties`
3. Ensure the server/world has these settings:
- Peaceful difficulty
- Adventure mode
- PvP enabled
- Command blocks enabled
4. Minimum of 6 players required.
5. Players board the train in the lobby.
6. Once 6+ players are aboard, ring the horn to begin.
